entries.scope: Four-dimensional Cartesian (+---), c=1 scalar sector with quadratic V=m2*phi^2/2 and a prescribed continuous source J independent of phi. Actual integral of the density difference, exact first variation, compact-support integration by parts and stationarity under every smooth compact variation iff box(phi)-m2*phi+J=0 for C2 phi. Absolute-action derivative is proved for compactly supported phi. Other sectors are held fixed; ME-013 sets J=lambda*I. Source-sign and field-dependent-source counterexamples are retained.
entries.remaining_obligation: Full metric variation, curved-spacetime covariance and volume form, joint dynamics of matter/EM/memory/environment, general nonlinear potentials, physical units, boundaries other than compact variations, general PDE existence/uniqueness, quantization and empirical identification remain open. ME-009 uses an authored prescribed-source scalar slice of Lrec. This does not derive the complete EFMW or quantum-gravity action, and does not identify its positive source with ME-002 without the proved sign condition.
